title: Figma Generator Registry Integration - Dynamic Configuration from component-registry.json
overview: Migrate remaining Figma generators from hardcoded configuration to dynamic reading from component-registry.json. This ensures generators stay in sync with React component changes automatically.

context.problem: Many generators use hardcoded SIZE_CONFIG, VARIANT_CONFIG, STATE_STYLES objects instead of reading from component-registry.json. When React components change, generators become out of sync and require manual updates.
context.current_state: Tests are complete (29/29 generators have structural + snapshot tests). However, only ~6 generators fully read from registry. The rest use hardcoded values that may drift from actual component implementations.
context.why_now: Tests are in place to catch regressions. Now is the time to standardize generators to use registry as single source of truth, making the system self-maintaining.

primary: Migrate all generators to read configuration from component-registry.json
Eliminate hardcoded SIZE_CONFIG, VARIANT_CONFIG, STATE_STYLES objects
Ensure generators automatically reflect React component changes
Maintain test coverage and snapshot stability
metrics: 100% of generators import and use component-registry.json
All existing tests continue to pass
Generators produce identical Figma output (snapshots unchanged or intentionally updated)

functional.title: Registry Import Pattern
functional.description: All generators must import configuration from component-registry.json
acceptance: Remove hardcoded SIZE_CONFIG, VARIANT_CONFIG, STATE_STYLES objects

functional.title: Styling Metadata Usage
functional.description: Generators should use styling section from registry when available
acceptance: Use styling.dimensions, styling.baseTokens, styling.states when present
Fall back to parsed Tailwind classes when styling section not available
Document which components need KUMO_*_STYLING exports added

functional.title: Backward Compatibility
functional.description: Generated Figma output must remain consistent
acceptance: Existing snapshots should not change (or changes must be intentional)

functional.title: Testable Export Updates
functional.description: Testable exports must reflect registry-based configuration
acceptance: Tests validate registry structure, not hardcoded values

non_functional.title: Code Consistency
non_functional.description: All generators follow same pattern for registry access

non_functional.title: Error Handling
non_functional.description: Graceful handling when registry data is missing
acceptance: Log warnings for missing registry entries
Throw clear errors for critical missing data

in_scope: Update testable exports to reflect registry-based configuration
Verify all existing tests continue to pass
Update progress.txt after each generator migration
Document any components needing KUMO_*_STYLING exports
out_of_scope: Adding new KUMO_*_STYLING exports (document as follow-up)

generators.name: input
generators.notes: Fully migrated. SIZE_CONFIG now reads from registry.components.Input.styling.sizeVariants. All 68 tests pass.

generators.name: select
generators.notes: Fully migrated. selectStyling now reads from KUMO_SELECT_STYLING structure (trigger, popup, option configs). STATE_STYLES uses selectStyling tokens. All 46 tests pass. Note: KUMO_SELECT_STYLING exists in select.tsx but not yet extracted to registry - needs codegen:registry to be run.

generators.name: tooltip
generators.notes: Fully migrated. Now uses correct colors from React component (bg-black-icon, text-white instead of bg-surface-3, text-surface). Added getTooltipStylingConfig() export. All 29 tests pass.

const sizeProp = componentProps.size as { values: string[]; classes: Record<string, string>; default: string; };
usage: // Instead of hardcoded: const SIZE_CONFIG = { xs: { height: 20 }, ... };

migration_steps: 1. Read current generator to understand hardcoded values
3. Add registry import and extract props/styling
5. Replace hardcoded config objects with parsed registry classes
6. Update testable exports to use registry data
7. Run tests to verify snapshots unchanged (or update intentionally)
8. Document if component needs KUMO_*_STYLING export added

button.ts - Complex multi-variant using registry props
checkbox.ts - Uses props and styling sections from registry
